aboutGame.title: What is Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea?
paragraphs: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is Natsume's newest farming and life-simulation adventure, released on October 15, 2026 for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam. You take over an overgrown farm in a world that needs rebuilding, then grow crops, raise animals, and restore the land at your own pace.

What sets Teradea apart is the scale around the farm. Four towns — Bloomfield, Tidewind, Quarrytop, and Maplehill — connect through an open world you explore with jumping, ladder climbing, and vine scaling. Animal companions travel with you, remote islands hide treasure and rare wildlife, and ten romance candidates give you plenty of reasons to stay a while.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea.

items.question: What is Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea?
items.answer: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is Natsume's farming and life-simulation adventure, released on October 15, 2026. You grow crops, raise animals, rebuild the land, and explore an open world of four towns, remote islands, and a mysterious Forest of Echoes.

items.question: Which platforms can I play Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea on?
items.answer: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea launched simultaneously on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam, and it is Steam Deck Verified for handheld PC play.

items.question: How many romance candidates are in Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea?
items.answer: There are ten romance candidates in Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea — five bachelors and five bachelorettes — spread across Bloomfield, Tidewind, Quarrytop, and Maplehill.

items.question: Is Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea an open world?
items.answer: Yes. Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea links its four towns through an open world, and jumping, ladder climbing, and vine scaling open vertical routes, remote islands, and hidden treasure.

items.question: What should beginners do first in Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea?
items.answer: Meet every villager on day one, clear a small plot, and plant cheap fast-growing seeds. Water every morning, forage on the way home, and save before you explore the wilderness.

items.question: Are there dangerous animals in Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea?
items.answer: Yes. Wolves, bears, and tigers roam certain regions of Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea and can cost you items if they catch you, so travel light, keep an escape route, and save before you explore.
